description: Preflight an essay, paper or article before submission. Returns word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time and Flesch reading ease, plus issues: in-text citations with no reference entry, references never cited, word limits, long sentences and paragraphs, unmatched quotes and brackets, spacing, repeated words, a/an, sentence capitals and common word confusions. Put the reference list after a heading such as "References" or "Works Cited". Suggestions only; it does not detect plagiarism or AI text.

checks.description: Check groups to run. Default: all except passive-voice.

requiredHeadings.description: Headings the draft must contain, e.g. ["Introduction", "Conclusion"].

text.description: The draft as plain text or Markdown. Separate paragraphs with blank lines.

name: check_draft
title: Check a draft
